items.role: Judicial Intern · Supreme Court of India
items.description: Preparing briefs on civil, criminal, transfer and special leave petitions, and assisting in the review of case records and court proceedings.
Researched human rights violations and took part in expert sessions. Won the closing Declamation Competition for a presentation on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities.

items.role: Judicial Intern · Supreme Court of India
items.description: Prepared notes on the facts and grounds of civil and criminal transfer petitions, briefed special leave petitions, and assisted in reviewing case records and court proceedings.
Assisted in defamation and commercial litigation, with research on maintainability, jurisdiction and procedural compliance.

items.organisation: Chambers of Sr. Adv. Pravin H. Parekh
items.description: Worked on maintainability of claims and counterclaims, compliance with pre-arbitral contractual mechanisms and procedural timelines. Received a letter of recommendation from Advocate Bibhuti Krishna for drafting various petitions.
Interned directly under National President Dr. Kavita Srivastava. Made court visits, attended seminars and protests, took ground interviews, conducted research and prepared short notes.
Assisted in drafting pleadings and applications in civil and criminal matters.
